title: Leo/need Chapter1 Episode21 Leo/need

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Playing in SEKAI was awesome, right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah, it felt so good.
It was perfect. Just perfect.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Look up. It's not SEKAI-level amazing, but the stars look pretty good here too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You're right, they're so pretty! Just like back then...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: ...Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I feel like I'm still walking on clouds!
This isn't a dream, right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's real. The song we played, and what we're feeling now, it's all real.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. And we still have school tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Guh... Shiho, don't kill the vibe like that!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. It's time to head home.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Take care. See you at school tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Sure! See you, guys!
The next day
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-B

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate A
rows.Line: Ho-na-mi! Morning!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Morning. There's something I need to tell you... Do you have a few minutes?

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate B
rows.Line: Yeah, sure. What's up?

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate A
rows.Line: Gosh, I had no idea.

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate B
rows.Line: Thanks for sharing this with us, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm sorry I kept it secret for so long...

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate A
rows.Line: No, no, it's understandable. We were worried about you, you know? You seemed so sad lately.

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate B
rows.Line: Yeah! But you didn't look like you wanted to talk, so we didn't know what to do about it.

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate A
rows.Line: Thank you for opening up. And...sorry I said those mean things about Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No worries! Shiho is actually very nice. I could introduce you to her, if you'd like.

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate B
rows.Line: Sure, I'd like to get to know her! By the way, do you guys have any gigs planned yet?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, we only just started... But once we do, you're invited!

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate A
rows.Line: Cool! I'm already hyped to see you on stage!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (If I'd only known it would be this easy.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I should have been honest with my friends. It was so silly of me to think they wouldn't understand.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Do you really think it's okay for us to be spying on Honami?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shush! She'll hear you!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We could've just waited for her to tell us how it went later. Why did I let you drag me along like this...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I was so worried, I couldn't sit still!
It looks like the talk went well, thankfully!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It will be nice if her friends can come to our gigs. I'm also glad Honami corrected their misconceptions about Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Meh, I don't care either way.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I do! I want more people to discover that you actually have a great personality.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're making me cringe. Anyway, classes are about to start. We'd better go.
After school
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Now that school is done, it's time for a band strategy meeting!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: For a what?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You know, we have to decide on a lot of things! Our band name for starters! Do you have any ideas?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Why are you looking at me?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I thought you'd be the expert when it comes to inventing cool names!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Do you have something in mind, Ichika?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, I haven't thought about it yet, but we should come up with something original that would suit us all.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Maybe something to do with stars? That meteor shower in the Leo constellation is an important memory for all of us.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I like that! Shiho, I didn't know you had a sentimental streak!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Now I regret saying anything...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Didn't that meteor shower have a name?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I told you back then, Saki...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It was the Leonids. Or maybe we could go with the French name? It's um...Les Léonides.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's nice. Sounds kind of like Leo need.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, let's spell that part need! To mean that everyone's needed!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You want it written...like this?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Leoneed? I think it's good.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, I can make it better! How about Leo/need?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What's the slash for?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe... It's a shooting star!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Having a shooting star in our name is a wonderful idea!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's just a slash but...I guess I can kind of see it now.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, guys! We have a band name! And by the way...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I wrote lyrics for a song Saki composed earlier.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You guys have already written a song? Nice.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's amazing! Can I see the lyrics?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Uh, maybe later? It's kind of embarrassing to have them read in front of me...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I hope we can all perform it... together.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Let's do that at Leo/need's first practice session.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yay!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay! So...this is the beginning of Leo/need.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. This is going to be great, everyone.
bgm_area00001
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm so happy that they found their true feelings.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yes. They became a really pretty song.
You seemed to like it a great deal.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I... I just really enjoyed singing together with them.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I wonder what songs they're going to create next. It'll be exciting to find out!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Miku, look up at the sky.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What a beautiful shooting star!
